results.summary_before: This design replicates the 74181 4-bit slice ALU twice to form an 8-bit ALU that performs arithmetic and logical operations on 8-bit words. It includes an SPI slave peripheral supporting all four SPI modes with eight configurable read/write registers and eight read-only status registers, and a multiplexer maps internal signals to a 7-segment display for debug. It is controlled from an RP2040 SPI1 master on GPIOs 24 to 27, and no external hardware is required. Silicon tests by the author confirmed read and write operations of all registers across all four SPI modes.

The project explores reversible gates for energy efficiency and requires no external hardware.
